description: Watch an element for changes instead of polling with MutationObserver/setInterval code in evaluate. collect: record text/attribute changes for 'duration' ms. until: wait for a condition, then optionally click at once (then_click). click_first fires the triggering action after the observer is armed, so nothing is missed.

click_first.description: Selector or ref to click once the observer is armed

duration.description: Collect window in ms (default 5000); exclusive with until

selector.description: CSS selector or ref of the element to observe

then_click.description: Selector or ref to click immediately when until holds

until.description: JS expression checked on each change, 'el' is the element, e.g. el.textContent === '8'

name: observe
